title: parasenecio pilgerianus
intro: Parasenecio pilgerianus, commonly known as Pilger's ragwort or Chinese Senecio, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, where it is used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Parasenecio pilgerianus include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic effects, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as alleviate respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as sedation, antitumor, and antiviral properties.
